title: Demesne
description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Energy[/gold] and draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
smart_description: At the start of your turn, gain Energy and draw additional cards. (Effect scales with stack count.)
notes: Counter power: Each stack increments the effect. For each stack, gain that much Energy and draw that many additional cards at turn start.
